roadmap.title: GoatVille
roadmap.description: Free-roam the base map to clear its tricks, quests, mutators, and 30 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Goat City Bay
roadmap.description: Clear the second free map, including its batteries, hats, blocks, parkour, and 30 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Goat MMO Simulator
roadmap.description: Work through the MMO map's classes, quests, zones, and 20 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: GoatZ
roadmap.description: Survive the zombie map and craft, kill, and collect its 32 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: PAYDAY
roadmap.description: Run the heist map's crew missions, pranks, and 20 goat trophies.

roadmap.title: Waste of Space
roadmap.description: Finish the space colony's progression, ship combat, and 30 goat trophies.

achievements.description: Hit the party with the Boulder of Death.
achievements.summary: Knock the giant boulder down the hill into the party.

steps.text: Push the giant boulder downhill from the path above the party so it rolls into the guests.

achievements.summary: Lick the Sanctum 1 Walker statue in the spawn house bedroom.

steps.text: Go upstairs in the house where you spawn and lick the Sanctum 1 Walker statue in the bedroom.

achievements.summary: Lick the Sanctum 2 Walker statue found in the treehouse by the spawn trampoline.

steps.text: Bounce on the trampoline next to the spawn house and use it to reach the treehouse, then lick the Sanctum 2 Walker statue.

achievements.description: Become the master of the goat tower.
achievements.summary: Reach the Infernal Throne at the top of the Goat Tower.

steps.text: Climb the spawn-yard goat tower and enter the door at the top to teleport to the Infernal Throne.

achievements.description: Everything the light touches is your kingdom.
achievements.summary: Reach the top of the crane, the highest point on the GoatVille map.

steps.text: Climb the construction site and use its fans to gain height, then land on top of the crane.
steps.note: The Angel Goat mutator lets you hover across to the crane at the top of your jumps.

achievements.summary: Knock over every stone at Goathenge.

steps.text: Go to the stone circle north of the spawn point and knock over every standing stone.

achievements.description: We are each our own devil, and we make this world our hell.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice five ragdolls on the pentagram beside the party hill.

steps.text: Take five ragdolls or people up the hill beside the party and drop them onto the pentagram.
steps.note: The Devil Goat mutator spawns goats, which is the quickest source of sacrifices.

achievements.summary: Avoid harming anyone for five minutes.

steps.text: Do not attack or damage anything for five minutes; standing still is enough.
steps.note: Attacking resets the timer but does not end the attempt.

achievements.description: Visit 5 trampolines in one jump, bouncing on each trampoline once.
achievements.summary: Bounce on five different trampolines in one jump.

steps.text: Bounce on five trampolines across the map without touching the ground, using ragdoll control between each.
steps.note: Start on the construction-site trampoline and finish on the one next to the spawn house to keep the chain alive.

achievements.summary: Sacrifice the three Sanctum items on the pentagram.

steps.text: Place the Sanctum 1 and Sanctum 2 Walker statues onto the pentagram on the hill by the party.
From the construction site crane, hover into the blue shipping container hanging below and headbutt the robot, then lick it.
Drag the robot onto the same pentagram.
steps.note: Headbutt the robot first or it knocks you out of the container before you can lick it.

achievements.description: Ooops, the game seems to have crashed.
achievements.summary: Crash the game and reopen it.

steps.text: Press ~ to open the console, type BeginBVT, and press Enter to crash the game.
Start Goat Simulator again to be awarded the achievement.

achievements.summary: Score 10 points in Flappy Goat.

steps.text: On the second floor of Coffee Stain Studios, play Flappy Goat and score 10 points.
steps.note: The R-key flap has a slight delay and the goat hitbox is large; begin each drop a little higher than the gap.

achievements.description: Do 10 front flips in one trick.
achievements.summary: Land one trick containing 10 front flips.

steps.text: Jump from a high point, hold the flip input through 10 front flips, and land on your feet.
steps.note: The low-gravity building and the Angel Goat give you enough height and airtime.

achievements.description: Drag a person into the treadmill with your tongue.
achievements.summary: Drag a person onto the treadmill in the spawn house garage.

steps.text: Lick a person and drag them onto the treadmill inside the spawn-house garage.

achievements.summary: Put the bacon on the empty pole in the crop circle and baa.

steps.text: Take the bacon from the garage behind the spawn point to the crop field.
Place it on the empty pole in the crop circle and press 1 to baa, then let the UFO carry you to space.

achievements.description: Find all the trophies in Goat Ville!
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 goat trophies hidden around GoatVille.

collectibles.method: Climb the site and use the roof fans, then a jetpack burst, to reach the cable.

collectibles.method: Ride the roadside shed's roof fan and land on the lower cable.

collectibles.name: Shed roof

collectibles.method: Land on its roof after triggering the fan.

collectibles.name: School shed
collectibles.location: Behind the shed opposite the school.
collectibles.method: Circle the building on its road-facing side.

collectibles.name: School bell
collectibles.location: Beneath the school bell.
collectibles.method: Ragdoll and slide under the bell.

collectibles.name: Size pit
collectibles.location: Rim of the size-changing pit.
collectibles.method: Walk the pit edge and lick the trophy.

collectibles.name: Boulder of Doom
collectibles.location: Behind the Boulder of Doom.
collectibles.method: Circle behind the boulder near the party.

collectibles.name: Fightclub fence
collectibles.location: Against the boundary fence behind the Goat Fightclub.
collectibles.method: Follow the fence through the field.

collectibles.name: Water slide bushes
collectibles.location: In the bushes below the water slide.
collectibles.method: Push into the undergrowth beneath the slide.

collectibles.name: Control room
collectibles.location: Scaffolding above the Low Gravity control room.
collectibles.method: Enter the fan room, jetpack-burst, and land on the office roof.

collectibles.name: Low Gravity roof
collectibles.location: Low Gravity roof, under a rotating girder.

collectibles.name: Vent
collectibles.location: In the roof vent of the Low Gravity room.
collectibles.method: Ride the room's fan up into the vent.

collectibles.name: Harvester
collectibles.location: Beside a small sedan right of the harvester.
collectibles.method: Walk into the field near the harvester.

collectibles.name: Power tower
collectibles.location: Beneath the power tower by the Goatagram.

collectibles.name: Construction scaffolding
collectibles.location: Rooftop scaffolding of the construction building.
collectibles.method: Climb the construction site to the roof platform.

collectibles.name: Tower goat
collectibles.location: Behind the goat atop the spawn tower.
collectibles.method: Climb the tower and look behind the goat.

collectibles.name: Field tree
collectibles.location: At the lone field tree.
collectibles.method: Lick the trophy at the tree base.

collectibles.name: Outhouse
collectibles.location: Right of the outhouse near the crop fields.

collectibles.name: Studio desk
collectibles.location: On an upstairs desk in Coffee Stain Studios.
collectibles.method: Go up and lick the desk trophy.

collectibles.name: Studio chimney
collectibles.location: Studio chimney.
collectibles.method: Climb the studio roof and walk to the chimney.

collectibles.name: Diving boards
collectibles.location: Highest diving board at the empty pool.
collectibles.method: Jump up to the top board.

collectibles.name: Hanging container
collectibles.location: Blue container hanging from the crane.
collectibles.method: Use the lower-roof fans, drop in, and headbutt the G2 robot before it shoves you out.

collectibles.name: Ground container
collectibles.location: Ground-level blue container at the construction site.
collectibles.method: Enter it from the road side.

collectibles.name: Protesters stage
collectibles.location: Behind the protesters stage.
collectibles.method: Circle the stage by the pool.

collectibles.name: Gas station
collectibles.location: Inside the gas station.
collectibles.method: Lick the trophy on the shop floor.

collectibles.name: Spawn bedroom
collectibles.location: Bedroom of the house beside the spawn.
collectibles.method: Check the corner right of the stairs.

collectibles.name: Time Trial greenhouse
collectibles.location: Greenhouse by the Time Trial start.
collectibles.method: Enter the greenhouse away from the spawn.

collectibles.name: Party trees
collectibles.location: Branch of a tree between the empty pool and the party.
collectibles.method: Jump or hover onto the branch.

collectibles.name: Throne room box
collectibles.location: Box in the Goat Castle throne room.

collectibles.name: Castle power pole
collectibles.location: Top of the power pole nearest the Goat Castle.
collectibles.method: Use the vents and ragdoll onto the goat at the top.

achievements.summary: Defeat all four goats in the crops field title bout.

steps.text: Go to the red ring in the crops field and force each of the four goats out of the circle by headbutting, kicking, or licking them.
steps.note: Each goat is tougher than the last; the Ripped Goat mutator makes the later rounds much easier.

achievements.description: Become the Queen of Goat Ville
achievements.summary: Sit on the throne inside the goat tower.

steps.text: Enter the goat tower by the spawn point and move up to sit on the throne inside.

achievements.description: Bounce 100 times on mattresses within 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Bounce on mattresses 100 times inside 30 seconds.

steps.text: Bounce on the mattresses on the floor and ceiling of the construction site's upper story and reach 100 bounces within 30 seconds.
steps.note: Avoid drifting off the mattresses or being flung out of the room.

achievements.summary: Lick the glider that circles the GoatVille map.

steps.text: Climb the crane, wait for the hanging glider to pass within reach, then jump and lick it.
steps.note: The Angel Goat helps you hover at the glider's height.

achievements.description: Make sure the Hillbilly never drives again.
achievements.summary: Crush the Hillbilly's car with the giant boulder.

steps.text: Push the giant boulder beside the party hill onto the Hillbilly as he drives through the fields.

achievements.description: Kick something in the air while doing a backflip
achievements.summary: Kick an object while performing a backflip.

steps.text: Start a backflip and press the kick input before landing while next to any object.
steps.note: At the big blue half pipe in Goat City Bay, jump off the edge, hold the right mouse button and S to flip, then left-click the ball.

achievements.description: Knock a bucket into a person
achievements.summary: Knock a bucket into a person.

steps.text: Headbutt a bucket into a person; several buckets sit near the GoatVille spawn point.

achievements.description: Kick a person into a car
achievements.summary: Kick a gas station customer into a car.

steps.text: At the gas station, walk backwards toward the man refuelling his car and left-click to kick him into the car.

achievements.description: Have 10 gas cannisters explode at the same time
achievements.summary: Explode ten gas canisters at the same time.

steps.text: On top of the dam, headbutt one canister in the cluster of ten gas canisters to detonate them together.

achievements.description: Wield an axe with your tongue
achievements.summary: Lick an axe.

steps.text: Lick one of the axes stuck into the blue house behind the protesters.

achievements.summary: Set a person on fire from a distance.

steps.text: Knock a person into an open fire or a hot grill while standing away from them.
steps.note: The grill by the Goat City Bay beach and the alley fire are the most reliable sources.

achievements.summary: Finish every wallrun quest in Goat City Bay.

guide.context: Wallrunning time counts while you are airborne, so chained jumps keep the wallrun going.

steps.text: Complete each wallrun quest in the Goat City Bay parkour area.
steps.note: Respawning several times stacks extra jumps that make the longer wallruns much easier.

achievements.summary: Complete all three manual quests.

guide.context: Manual mode rates each trick you land; the score only registers when you stop moving to a standstill.

steps.text: In Manual mode, earn 1000 points, stop moving to register the score, and repeat until all three quests are complete.

achievements.description: Paint with all the colors of the wind
achievements.summary: Return the wind statue to the wind altar.

steps.text: Climb the middle of the three white wind turbines right of the hotels and lick the wind statue at the top.
Carry the statue to the wind altar behind the big blue half pipe and place it there.

achievements.summary: Headbutt the DJ at the hotel rooftop concert and party.

steps.text: Ride the Put-In Hotel elevator to the roof, headbutt Deadmau5 to take his head, then press R to party.

achievements.description: Why did you step in that? Yuck
achievements.summary: Enter the storm drain beside the carnival river.

steps.text: Crawl into the riverside drain pipe by the carnival to gain the repulsive power.

achievements.summary: Deliver the towel marked 42 to the UFO.

steps.text: Ride the hotel elevator to the roof, drop to the lower pool deck facing the ocean, and lick the folded towel marked 42.
Carry the towel to the UFO on the hill past the big blue half pipe.

achievements.description: Ride the boat while on a sugar rush
achievements.summary: Reach the marina boat while the sugar rush is active.

steps.text: Lick the sugar inside the pink spawn house, then race to the marina boat before the sugar rush ends.
steps.note: Clipping the boat as you jump over it counts.

achievements.summary: Collect all three Minecraft blocks in Goat City Bay.

steps.text: Pick up the three blocks: by the carnival water and speed boat, at the wind-turbine graveyard, and in the field north of the skatepark right of the boulders.

achievements.description: Get on top of the Parkour obstacle course
achievements.summary: Reach the top of the parkour obstacle course.

steps.text: Climb to the top of the parkour obstacle course near the skatepark.
steps.note: The Angel Goat or Anti-Gravity Goat skips most of the course.

achievements.summary: Buy all six hats from the hat shop.

steps.text: Collect six money packs and purchase every hat from the hat shop.
steps.note: Money packs: two inside the pink spawn house, one in the neighbouring shop, two on the hotel floor above reception, and one at the carnival behind the coaster lift.

achievements.description: Get up on the skyscraper without using the elevator
achievements.summary: Reach the top of the skyscraper without using the elevator.

steps.text: Swim out to the whale in the ocean, ride its blowhole launch, and steer onto the skyscraper.

achievements.summary: Defeat all four turtles in the sewer.

steps.text: Enter the sewer by the skyscraper, go to the first left-hand room, and kick or headbutt all four turdles.

achievements.summary: Ride a bike for 60 seconds.

steps.text: At the bike rack by the brown Club Styu Man building next to the blue half pipe, press R to mount a bike, wedge the front wheel against the wall, and ride in place for 60 seconds.

achievements.summary: Wear a fedora while the repulsive power is active.

guide.context: This achievement is glitched: the repulsive mutator must be equipped before the map loads, or the fedora will not register.

steps.text: Start Goat City Bay with the Repulsive Goat mutator equipped, buy a fedora from the hat shop, and press R to activate the repulsive power.

achievements.summary: Lick the pot labelled JACK in the residential white house.

steps.text: Enter the white house with the garage in the residential area and lick the pot labelled JACK in the pink-walled second-floor room.

achievements.description: Find all the trophies in Goat City Bay.
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 goat trophies hidden around Goat City Bay.

collectibles.method: Check the corner as you enter.

collectibles.name: Casino
collectibles.location: On the casino floor.
collectibles.method: Lick the trophy inside the casino.

collectibles.name: Skyscraper balcony
collectibles.location: Balcony edge of the skyscraper.
collectibles.method: Climb up and walk the edge.

collectibles.name: Concert corner
collectibles.location: Concert corner by the tower.
collectibles.method: On the hotel roof, check the tower corner.

collectibles.name: Toy store window
collectibles.location: Toy store display window.
collectibles.method: Lick the trophy through the glass.

collectibles.name: Homeless alley
collectibles.location: Alley with the homeless camp and fire.

collectibles.name: Club Nubian machine
collectibles.location: Grating on the large machine beside the gas canisters near Club Nubian.
collectibles.method: Ride the fan to the roof and cross over.

collectibles.name: Dura billboard
collectibles.location: In front of the Dura billboard facing the skyscraper.

collectibles.name: Nubian balcony
collectibles.location: Balcony table just under the roofline above Club Nubian.

collectibles.name: River walkway
collectibles.location: River boardwalk near the Matriarch and Club Nubian.
collectibles.method: Follow the walkway along the water.

collectibles.name: Vase shop walkway
collectibles.location: Boardwalk end past the vase shop, near the dam and bridge.

collectibles.name: Sewer turtle room
collectibles.location: Turtle room in the sewer.
collectibles.method: Enter the sewer and clear the room.

collectibles.name: Park ticket booth
collectibles.location: On the Cabrito Park entrance ticket booth.

collectibles.name: Spinning ride
collectibles.location: On the Cabrito Park spinning ride.
collectibles.method: Jump on as the ride descends.

collectibles.name: Park dock boat
collectibles.location: Moored boat on the Cabrito Park dock past the Ferris wheel.

collectibles.name: Coaster platform
collectibles.location: Cabrito Park roller coaster boarding platform.
collectibles.method: Ride or climb to the platform.

collectibles.name: Beach rock
collectibles.location: Rock at the water's edge on the Cabrito Park beach.
collectibles.method: Walk the shoreline behind the park.

collectibles.name: Gallery Doe
collectibles.location: On a trash can in Gallery Doe.
collectibles.method: Enter the gallery and lick it.

collectibles.name: Miram Core water tower
collectibles.location: Water tower atop the Miram Core roof.
collectibles.method: Bounce off Uncle Fred's Workshop mattress to cross.

collectibles.name: Lower roof
collectibles.location: Lower roof near the beach in the Miram Core block.
collectibles.method: Drop from the water tower side.

collectibles.name: Goat Forest fence
collectibles.location: Along the Goat Forest fence.

collectibles.name: Atory tunnel rock
collectibles.location: Behind a rock near the Atory City tunnel.

collectibles.name: Parkour course top
collectibles.location: Summit of the parkour course.
collectibles.method: Reach the top of the course.

collectibles.name: Skyscraper island
collectibles.location: On the island reached by the skyscraper boat.
collectibles.method: Ride the boat out and lick the trophy.

achievements.description: Lick the rollercoaster with 6 batteries attached
achievements.summary: Lick the roller coaster after attaching all six batteries.

steps.text: Attach all six batteries to the roller coaster to supercharge it.
Ride or climb to the top of the coaster and lick it.
steps.note: Batteries: beside the coaster, behind the hotel bar desk, on the hotel roof behind the DJ, in an alley container across from the hotel, on the water-silo building, and on the middle-block white building behind barrels near a man tending a grill.

achievements.description: Get to a depth of 200 in SteamWorld Goat.
achievements.summary: Reach depth 200 in the SteamWorld Goat minigame.

steps.text: On the residential-area big TV, play SteamWorld Goat and descend to depth 200.
steps.note: Spawning with the Goat Queen mutator and spamming special to drop the frame rate lets your character fall through the blocks to the bottom.

achievements.description: Go on the catapult with a rider on your back
achievements.summary: Get launched by the catapult while carrying a rider.

steps.text: Knock over the mechanical bull behind the carnival roller coaster so a human climbs onto your back.
Carry the rider to the catapult near the dam and jump in.

achievements.summary: Lick the blue crystal in Uncle Fred's Workshop.

steps.text: Enter Uncle Fred's Workshop in Goat City Bay and lick the floating blue crystal marked DO NOT LICK!!.

achievements.summary: Reach level 101 in Goat MMO Simulator.

steps.text: Earn experience until you reach level 101, mainly by scoring flips and tricks in the air.
steps.note: Mix the Angel, Anti-Gravity, Tank, and Double Jump mutators, hold W+A or S+D to spin, and press 1 before you land for huge experience gains.

achievements.description: Do a lot of hurt. With your butt.
achievements.summary: Damage NPCs with the Tank's butt-slam.

steps.text: Choose the Tank class and baa repeatedly next to NPCs to hurt them with Butt-Slam.

achievements.description: Visit all zones on the MMO level
achievements.summary: Visit every zone in Goat MMO Simulator.

guide.context: Most zones unlock through normal play; the one players miss is Twistram Cathedral, up the hill behind Twistram.

steps.text: Travel through all MMO zones: Snowflake Factory, Goldfield, Goatshire and your house there, the Jousting Tournament, Mermaid's Tail, Twistram and its cathedral, Goatwind, Alvesta, Bullgrurzh, Glarblargle Beach, and Old Goat Mountain.

achievements.summary: Bring Steve Works his five apples.

steps.text: In the Gold Farm, lick five apples near Steve Works and place them inside the circle around him.

achievements.summary: Lick a goat named after a friend on your Steam friends list.

guide.context: The named goat appears at random, so you may need to enter and leave Goatwind repeatedly until it spawns.

steps.text: Load Goat MMO with a friend who owns the game online, then sweep Goatwind both within the walls and beyond the gates and lick any goat whose white name matches that friend.
steps.note: Red-named goats are enemies and do not count.

achievements.summary: Get hit by a horse to unlock the jousting mutator.

steps.text: Stand in the path of the horse that patrols the Goatwind Wall road; it runs west toward Mermaid's Tail.

achievements.summary: Complete Ariel Waterhouse's mermaid quest in Goatshire.

steps.text: Take the quest from Ariel Waterhouse in the Goatshire tavern.
Follow the river and waterfall to Glarblargle Beach, add Miranda the Mermaid to your inventory, and return her to Ariel.

achievements.description: Unlock the wheel of time mutator
achievements.summary: Headbutt the golden wheel in the Bullgrurzh cave.

steps.text: Head into the beachside cave below Old Goat Mountain and headbutt the golden wheel at its far end.

achievements.description: OMG IS THAT WHAT I THINK IT IS?
achievements.summary: Reach the Old Goat at the top of Old Goat Mountain.

steps.text: Take the king's quest in Goatwind, then climb Old Goat Mountain, enter the castle, and reach the Old Goat.

achievements.summary: Pull the sword from the stone in Alvesta.

steps.text: Lick the sword in the stone across the lake in Alvesta, then move away to pull it free.

achievements.summary: Kill ten bears for Bjorn Hayterr.

steps.text: Take Bjorn Hayterr's quest north of the Goatwind wall and kill ten bears.

achievements.summary: Land in the purple sphere at the top of Old Goat Mountain.

steps.text: Ride the lava pools that launch you upward in Old Goat Mountain until you reach and land in the purple sphere at the top of the tower.

achievements.summary: Enter the portal Dumbledoor the Grey opens in Twistram.

steps.text: Take Dumbledoor the Grey's quest in Twistram.
Kill a demon in Old Goat Mountain for its horn and bring it back to Dumbledoor.
Enter the portal he opens.

achievements.summary: Board the boat at the Twistram dock.

steps.text: Swim to the boat docked behind a building in Twistram and lick it to stay aboard for the trip.

achievements.summary: Drop into the hole behind the tree south of Goatshire.

steps.text: Go to the waterfall's top south of Goatshire and drop into the hole behind the tree where the girl sits.

achievements.summary: Baa with the Alvesta choir.

steps.text: Enter the rightmost treehouse in Alvesta and press 1 to baa next to the choir.

achievements.summary: Trash the hidden server room in Alvesta.

steps.text: Find the hidden server room on the western edge of Alvesta and headbutt the servers until an error appears.

achievements.displayName: One man, two shots and a religion
achievements.summary: Complete Ken Buddah's knee quest in Goatwind.

steps.text: Accept Ken Buddah's quest in Goatwind and jump on his button five times.

achievements.description: Throw the dwarf Bilbo into the lava
achievements.summary: Hurl the dwarf Bilbo into a lava pool on Old Goat Mountain.

steps.text: Find Bilbo in Bullgrurzh near the south-western beach and add him to your inventory.
Carry him up Old Goat Mountain and drop him into lava.

achievements.description: Do a card trick at the magician
achievements.summary: Perform a card trick beside the magician in Goatwind.

steps.text: With the Magician class equipped, perform its card ability beside the magician performing in Goatwind.

achievements.summary: Collect all six goat mutators from the GoatVille and Goat City Bay trophies.

guide.context: The six trophy mutators come from the two trophy sets: 5, 10, 20, and 30 GoatVille trophies, and 10 and 20 Goat City Bay trophies.

steps.text: Collect enough GoatVille and Goat City Bay trophies to unlock Tall, Feather, Giant, Space, Classy, and Shopping Goat, then lick any collectible to trigger the unlock.

achievements.summary: Stand in the bonfire at the entrance to Twistram.

steps.text: Jump into the campfire by the entrance to Twistram.

achievements.description: Find all the trophies on the MMO Level.
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 goat trophies hidden around Goat MMO Simulator.

collectibles.name: Sheep catapults
collectibles.location: Beside the sheep catapults in the Gold Fields.

collectibles.location: Island east of Twistram.

collectibles.name: Twistram house
collectibles.location: Upper floor of the northernmost Twistram house.

collectibles.name: Cathedral altar
collectibles.location: On the Twistram Cathedral altar.
collectibles.method: Take the hill behind Twistram into the cathedral.

collectibles.name: Mermaid's Tail tower
collectibles.location: Stone tower south of Mermaid's Tail.

collectibles.name: Mermaid's Tail bridge
collectibles.location: Beside a waterside tree just north of the Mermaid's Tail bridge.
collectibles.method: Search the shoreline by the bridge.

collectibles.method: Climb the falls and cross the water.

collectibles.name: Alvesta tree roots
collectibles.location: Behind a large tree's roots on Alvesta's north edge.

collectibles.name: Alvesta treehouse
collectibles.location: In the treehouse building reached by the ramps.

collectibles.name: Mermaid hut
collectibles.location: In a shoreline mermaid hut north of Queen Blarg.
collectibles.method: Enter the huts at the water's edge on Glarblargle Beach.

collectibles.name: Beach island
collectibles.location: Island west of Queen Blarg.
collectibles.method: Swim to it from Glarblargle Beach.

collectibles.name: Old Goat Mountain cliff
collectibles.location: West cliff of Old Goat Mountain, between two lit braziers.
collectibles.method: Follow the path west from Glarblargle Beach.

collectibles.name: Old Goat's room
collectibles.location: Scaled-up room past the Old Goat Mountain portal, on a toilet behind the fireplace.
collectibles.method: Enter the portal, clear the course, and wallrun above the fireplace.

achievements.description: It never erupts when you want it to.
achievements.summary: Ride the geyser on Glarblargle Beach as it erupts.

guide.context: Standing on or near the geyser stops it from spraying, so you have to arrive from above.

steps.text: At the geyser on the eastern side of Glarblargle Beach, fall onto the water stream as it erupts to be launched upward.
steps.note: Anti-Gravity and Double Jump make the timing far easier.

achievements.description: Craft all the weapons in one game
achievements.summary: Craft every weapon at the GoatZ workbench in one game.

steps.text: At the workbench beside the spawn, craft every weapon recipe in a single game.
steps.note: This unlocks together with Survivalist when you craft the full recipe list.

achievements.description: Craft all items in one game
achievements.summary: Craft every item at the GoatZ workbench in one game.

steps.text: At the workbench beside the spawn, craft every item recipe in a single game.
steps.note: Gather the required ingredients first; the full recipe list is shown at the workbench.

achievements.summary: Survive 10 days in GoatZ.

steps.text: Survive the GoatZ survival mode until 10 days have passed.
steps.note: Learn food and crafting locations in the pre-apocalypse map first, then repeat in the post-apocalypse map.

achievements.description: Crystallize and break 30 zombies in one game
achievements.summary: Crystallize and shatter 30 zombies in one GoatZ game.

steps.text: Collect the 3 barrels beside the RV hidden in the mountains behind the barn, then enter the RV and lick the crystal to gain the crystallize power.
Crystallize and shatter 30 zombies in the same game.
steps.note: Barrels sit in the barn, on top of the mall, and right beside the RV.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 zombies in one GoatZ game.

steps.text: Defeat 20 zombies in a single GoatZ game.

achievements.description: Eat 50 food items in one game
achievements.summary: Eat 50 food items in one GoatZ game.

steps.text: Eat 50 food items in a single GoatZ game.
steps.note: You will likely reach 50 while going for the 10-day survival achievement.

achievements.description: Paraglide in the air for 1 minute
achievements.summary: Paraglide for one minute without landing.

steps.text: Use the trampoline at the base of the taller Whiplash tower to reach the roof, jump, and glide for one minute before landing.

achievements.summary: Kill 7 zombies with one minifun in GoatZ.

guide.context: Minifuns are rare and come from fallen supply crates, not the tutorial.

steps.text: Find a minifun in the supply crates that drop around the map, then kill 7 zombies with that one weapon.

achievements.description: Hit 5 zombies in one bullet dive
achievements.summary: Hit 5 zombies with one bullet dive.

steps.text: Grab the Prototype mutator from the golden tower's summit, then bullet dive into 5 clustered zombies.

achievements.description: Hit 4 at once with a voodoo bomb
achievements.summary: Hit 4 zombies with one voodoo bomb.

steps.text: With the Voodoo Goat mutator active, catch 4 zombies in one bomb blast.
Try the mall, where zombies gather in groups.

achievements.summary: Play GoatSimSim for five minutes.

steps.text: Enter the small goat area by the barn next to the alien ship and stay in GoatSimSim for five minutes.

achievements.description: Beat the whiplash course without getting wet
achievements.summary: Finish the Whiplash course without touching the water.

steps.text: Complete the Whiplash course by the two tall towers without touching the water; you can retry as often as you like.

achievements.description: Make the stew taste as good as HUMANLY possible
achievements.summary: Drop a human into the stew on the island below the UFO.

steps.text: Jump into the hole by the crashed UFO where protesters stand, climb the island you land on, and drop a human into the stew at the top.

achievements.description: Clear 25 survival quests in one game
achievements.summary: Complete 25 survival quests in one GoatZ game.

steps.text: Complete 25 of the timed survival quests that appear in the corner of the screen during one game.
steps.note: Let a quest's timer run out to skip one you cannot do.

achievements.description: Use the slippery slide to land in the kiddie pool
achievements.summary: Ride the slippery slide and glide into the kiddie pool.

steps.text: Take the glider at the Whiplash slide, ride down, and steer into the kiddie pool.

achievements.description: Find all the trophies in GoatZ
achievements.summary: Collect all 32 goat trophies hidden around GoatZ.

collectibles.name: Spawn wall
collectibles.location: Below the spawn point, against a wall.
collectibles.method: Drop down from spawn and check the wall.

collectibles.name: Church roof
collectibles.location: Top of the church near spawn.

collectibles.name: Grave path
collectibles.location: Behind the spawn grave: follow the path, pass the small building, and check below the timber bridge.
collectibles.method: Look under the bridge on the path.

collectibles.name: Suspension bridge
collectibles.location: On a wooden plank below the suspension bridge.

collectibles.name: Sand island
collectibles.location: Small sand island reached by circling the cliff face to the right after jumping toward the ocean.
collectibles.method: Jump seaward and hug the cliff.

collectibles.name: Green Screen cage
collectibles.location: In a metal cage above Green Screen Studios' skate ramp.
collectibles.method: Reach the cage above the ramp.

collectibles.name: Stage 2 light
collectibles.location: On top of the light fixture in Stage 2 at Green Screen Studios, to the left.

collectibles.name: Red containers
collectibles.location: Atop the red shipping containers beside Stage 2.

collectibles.name: Billboards
collectibles.location: Between the two billboards along the road.
collectibles.method: Use the Angel Goat from Studio 2's roof to reach them.

collectibles.name: Barn beam
collectibles.location: On the wooden beam above the large hole beside the barn.

collectibles.name: Crashed UFO
collectibles.location: Beside the crashed UFO behind the barn.

collectibles.name: Barn interior
collectibles.location: Inside the barn.
collectibles.method: Enter the barn and lick it.

collectibles.name: Goat pen
collectibles.location: In the goat pen before the barn, behind a mound under cover.

collectibles.name: Hole hut
collectibles.location: In a hut toward the back after jumping into the large hole and climbing the cliffside.
collectibles.method: Climb out of the hole and check the huts.

collectibles.name: RV rear
collectibles.location: Behind the RV.

collectibles.name: Mall rocks
collectibles.location: In a small rock hole on the mall's left flank.

collectibles.name: Mall bathroom
collectibles.location: In the men's bathroom on the mall's second floor.

collectibles.name: Supermarket till
collectibles.location: Behind the register at the mall supermarket.

collectibles.name: Mall rooftop
collectibles.location: Behind barrels on the mall roof by the bathrooms.

collectibles.name: Transmission tower
collectibles.location: High on the mountain's transmission tower.

collectibles.name: Circus cave
collectibles.location: In a cave beside the fairground circus tent.

collectibles.name: Behind the tent
collectibles.location: Behind the circus tent, behind a group of NPCs.

collectibles.name: Whiplash sign
collectibles.location: Atop the big sign behind the Whiplash letters.

collectibles.name: Round sign
collectibles.location: On the large round Whiplash sign, reached via the roof vent of the building below.
collectibles.method: Use the vent to get onto the sign.

collectibles.name: Spinning obstacle
collectibles.location: On one of the Whiplash course's spinning obstacles.

collectibles.name: Hotel scaffolding
collectibles.location: On the scaffolding at the rear of the large hotel, about halfway up.

collectibles.name: Golden building top
collectibles.location: At the summit of the big golden building beside the hotel.

collectibles.name: Golden ledge
collectibles.location: On a black ledge of the golden building, seen by looking over the top edge.

collectibles.name: Green plus balcony
collectibles.location: On a rear balcony of the green-plus building, behind an NPC.

collectibles.name: Parking sign
collectibles.location: Among the trees left of the fairground tunnel, near a parking sign.
collectibles.method: Search the trees by the tunnel.

collectibles.name: Beach path
collectibles.location: Under the wooden path leading to the beach.

collectibles.name: Metal structure
collectibles.location: Inside a little metal hut by the food stall at the large statue, against the golden building.
collectibles.method: Search the hut by the food stall.

achievements.summary: Toast two slices of bread in the toaster by the party.

steps.text: Headbutt the toaster beside the BBQ party, lick the slice of bread it throws onto the blue roof, and return it to the toaster.
Find the second slice travelling along the sidewalk down the street, lick it, and put it in the toaster.
Weigh down the toaster lever to cook the bread.

achievements.description: Find all the trophies on the Payday Level.
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 goat trophies hidden around the PAYDAY map.

collectibles.name: Spawn cage
collectibles.location: On top of the metal cage immediately left of the spawn.

collectibles.name: Trailer park
collectibles.location: Behind a trailer on your right toward the small trailer park.
collectibles.method: Head out of spawn and check behind the trailers.

collectibles.name: Drive-in screen
collectibles.location: Beneath the drive-in cinema screen.

collectibles.name: Train tracks
collectibles.location: Behind a wooden panel by the trampoline beneath the train tracks.
collectibles.method: Knock the panel away to reveal it.

collectibles.name: Red roof
collectibles.location: On a corner of the red building's roof near the hot air balloon.

collectibles.name: Floating rock
collectibles.location: On the floating rock outside town.

collectibles.name: Flarebud billboard
collectibles.location: On the Flarebud billboard.

collectibles.name: Fast food kitchen
collectibles.location: Inside the fast food restaurant kitchen.

collectibles.name: Police courtyard
collectibles.location: In the police station courtyard.

collectibles.name: Aerobics alley
collectibles.location: On mattresses in the alley across from the cinema and left of the Aerobics Center.

collectibles.name: Slot machines
collectibles.location: In the middle of the circular slot machine cluster inside the casino.
collectibles.method: Stand inside the slot machine ring.

collectibles.name: Casino roof
collectibles.location: On the casino roof.

collectibles.name: Cinema terrace
collectibles.location: Behind the bar on the cinema's upper terrace.

collectibles.name: Grey building
collectibles.location: Atop the big grey building.

collectibles.name: Track billboard
collectibles.location: On a roof below a billboard by the train tracks.

collectibles.name: Beach building
collectibles.location: Behind a small hut on the beach, by the speedboat near the ship.

collectibles.name: Ship building
collectibles.location: Atop the building right beside the ship.

collectibles.name: Peninsula
collectibles.location: At the tip of the small peninsula in front of the ship.

collectibles.name: Desert rock
collectibles.location: On a rock in the desert near a wrecked car and the river.

collectibles.name: River pier
collectibles.location: At the end of the pier on the small round pond where the river splits.

achievements.description: Win 3 hands at a Blackjack table.
achievements.summary: Win three blackjack hands.

guide.context: The three wins may have to happen within a single session of the game.

steps.text: At the casino blackjack tables on the right, win three hands; they need not be consecutive.

achievements.description: Just finish that one LAST job.
achievements.summary: Finish all BAAA machine missions.

steps.text: Finish every mission offered by the BAAA machine.
steps.note: Earning a lot of cash for the mask achievement happens naturally while finishing these missions.

achievements.description: Show off your vehicle air control skills in the desert.
achievements.summary: Pass through all eight green rings on the desert track.

steps.text: Drive the buggy off the ramp near the desert track finish line and fly through all 8 green rings.
steps.note: The flamingo can also fly through the rings.

achievements.summary: Travel to the moon.

steps.text: Complete the BAAA machine missions so the trip to the moon is granted.
steps.note: This unlocks alongside Retirement.

achievements.description: Use a cannon to travel to the Island in the Sky.
achievements.summary: Use the cannon to reach the Island in the Sky.

steps.text: At the cannon on the rocks beside the hot air balloon and the smaller police station, aim for the tree on the floating island and fire.

achievements.summary: Throw five police officers into prison.

steps.text: Lick five officers and drag them into the jail at the bigger police station by the skyscrapers.

achievements.summary: Wear 30 masks at the same time.

steps.text: Earn enough cash, buy 30 masks from the BAAA Machine, and equip them all onto one character.
steps.note: Roughly 750 dollars covers the masks; finishing the BAAA missions supplies most of it.

achievements.description: Listen to the whole pan flute song.
achievements.summary: Listen to the complete pan flute song.

steps.text: Pay the band in the courtyard of the bank near the hot air balloon and stay until the song ends.

achievements.summary: Enable the hydraulic cars.

steps.text: Take the boombox from the Aerobics Center to the restaurant parking lot next to the police station.

achievements.description: Charm a cow using Valentino Salami.
achievements.summary: Charm a cow with Valentino Salami.

steps.text: As the Flamingo, lick a cow at the farm near the dirt track and press R to charm it.

achievements.description: Use Dolph Spaghetti to lift a crewmember on top of the tallest building.
achievements.summary: As Dolph Spaghetti, carry a crew member onto the tallest building's roof.

steps.text: As Dolph Spaghetti, whose wheelchair climbs walls, lick a crew member and ride up the tallest building with the circular top.

achievements.summary: Hogtie 50 NPCs.

steps.text: Unlock the Hogtie mutator by collecting 10 golden heart goatday trophies, then press R next to NPCs to tie them until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Spray the dancers using Humphrey Ciabatta.
achievements.summary: Spray the six dancers with Humphrey Ciabatta.

guide.context: All six dancers must be on stage for the spray to count.

steps.text: As Humphrey Ciabatta, use the camel's spray ability on all 6 dancers on the casino stage, aiming with the green reticle.
steps.note: If only four dancers appear, raise every graphics setting to maximum.

achievements.description: Lick all crew members together to form a Goatipede.
achievements.summary: Form a Goatipede with all four crew members.

steps.text: Have the second crew member lick the first, the third lick the second, and the fourth lick the third so all four form a line.

achievements.description: Gather the crew for some drive-in movies.
achievements.summary: Bring the whole crew to the drive-in movie theater in one car.

steps.text: Load all four crew members into a single car and drive them to the drive-in theater near the desert track start line.

achievements.description: Place a Hogtied NPC on the train tracks.
achievements.summary: Put a hogtied NPC onto the railway tracks.

guide.context: Hogtie needs the Hogtie mutator, unlocked by collecting 10 golden heart goatday trophies and then chosen from the mutator menu.

steps.text: Hogtie an NPC, drag them onto the train tracks, and wait for a train to run them over.

achievements.description: Headbutt someone out of their car, then run them over!
achievements.summary: Run over a driver with their own car.

steps.text: Headbutt the driver out of a moving car, get in, and run them over.

achievements.description: Pickup a photon sword as father or good goat.
achievements.summary: Pick up a photon sword as the father or good goat.

steps.text: At the south-west corner of the colony, push the human sacrifice into the lava pit for the father goat or the ball pit for the good goat.
Pick up any lightsaber, such as one from the Photon Sword Shop north of that spot.

achievements.summary: Destroy every freighter in the spaceship.

steps.text: Fly the spaceship and destroy every yellow target, the freighters.

achievements.summary: Destroy every pirate ship in the spaceship.

steps.text: Fly the spaceship and destroy every red target, the pirate ships.

achievements.summary: Shoot down 30 police ships in the spaceship.

steps.text: Fly the spaceship and destroy 30 blue targets, the police ships.

achievements.summary: Destroy 100 asteroids in the spaceship.

steps.text: Fly the spaceship and shoot 100 asteroids.

achievements.displayName: What came first? The alien or the egg?
achievements.summary: Headbutt every alien egg in the alien lair.

steps.text: Go to the alien lair in the north-west of the colony and headbutt all of the green glowing eggs, about 30 of them.

achievements.summary: Survive the centrifuge until it reaches 20G.

steps.text: After completing the academy, ride the centrifuge attraction and stay seated until it reaches 20G.
steps.note: The Ripped Goat mutator helps you stay in the seats.

achievements.summary: Collect 10 goat trophies in Waste of Space.

steps.text: Pick up any 10 of the 30 Waste of Space trophies; the NERD! entry lists every location.

achievements.displayName: Wow is that a limited edition?
achievements.summary: Collect 20 goat trophies in Waste of Space.

steps.text: Pick up any 20 of the 30 Waste of Space trophies; the NERD! entry lists every location.

achievements.summary: Collect all 30 goat trophies hidden around Waste of Space.

collectibles.name: Crowdkicker Central
collectibles.location: Above a receptionist under a Crowdkicker sign.
collectibles.method: Look above the receptionist inside Crowdkicker Central.

collectibles.name: Landing pad elevator
collectibles.location: Concealed inside the landing-pad elevator.

collectibles.name: Museum water
collectibles.location: Under the walkway in the water on the left side of the museum.
collectibles.method: Check beneath the walkway over the water.

collectibles.name: Museum asteroid
collectibles.location: Inside the cracked earth model after dislodging the large asteroid upstairs in the museum building.
collectibles.method: Go upstairs, knock the asteroid loose, and look inside the model.

collectibles.name: Research Dome pillar
collectibles.location: On top of the light pillar right of the 3D printer in the Research Dome.

collectibles.name: Research Dome parking
collectibles.location: Under a walkway left of the parking in the Research Dome.

collectibles.name: T-xas wall
collectibles.location: Past the wall on the right in T-xas, reached via the travel agency.
collectibles.method: Go over the wall and keep right.

collectibles.name: Shuttle pipe
collectibles.location: On the pipe above the space shuttle in T-xas.

collectibles.name: Academy ramp
collectibles.location: Beneath the Academy Dome's left Segway ramp.

collectibles.name: Academy tower
collectibles.location: At the top of the tallest building, reached by jump pads.
collectibles.method: Use the jump pads to reach the summit.

collectibles.name: Carrier canteen
collectibles.location: Visible from outside the canteen table on the right of the Carrier.

collectibles.name: Carrier bathroom
collectibles.location: At the end of the hallway toward the bathrooms in the Carrier crew quarters.
collectibles.method: Take a right down the hall.

collectibles.name: Carrier storage
collectibles.location: Behind the servers after smashing the wall in Carrier storage.
collectibles.method: Detonate the small red explosive and break through the wall.

collectibles.name: Carrier ceiling hole
collectibles.location: In the hole near the ceiling on the Carrier's second level.
collectibles.method: Dislodge a couple of cables to enable anti-gravity, then jump up left.

collectibles.name: Research Dome tardis
collectibles.location: At the top of the tallest diving board inside the Research Dome tardis.
collectibles.method: Enter the tardis and climb the board.

collectibles.name: Test chamber elevator
collectibles.location: Beside the doorway to the next room after riding the test chamber elevator to the top.
collectibles.method: Ride the elevator all the way up.

collectibles.name: White structure
collectibles.location: Under the large white structure outside the test chamber, around some pillars.

collectibles.name: Test chamber sign
collectibles.location: Directly right of the sign down the road from the test chamber.

collectibles.name: Quarry cliff
collectibles.location: On a cliff face at the quarry opposite the Aries signs inside the colony.

collectibles.name: Quarry container
collectibles.location: Inside a shipping container at the quarry.

collectibles.name: Capsule hotel
collectibles.location: On the ground floor of the single capsule hotel beside the museum.

collectibles.name: Alien cages
collectibles.location: Behind some rocks near the caged humans in the alien infestation area.

collectibles.name: Dome right
collectibles.location: On the Research Dome's right side, by some jedi.

collectibles.name: Vault receptacle
collectibles.location: Inside the receptacle by the vault door across the Research Dome.
collectibles.method: Lick the radioactive barrel behind the podracer and carry it to the receptacle.

collectibles.name: Aries billboard
collectibles.location: On top of the Aries billboard around the Academy Dome in the colony.

collectibles.name: Crater asteroid
collectibles.location: Revealed by dislodging the large asteroid in the crater around the Academy Dome.

collectibles.name: Capsule walkway
collectibles.location: On the walkway near the top of the capsule-shaped building south-east of the previous trophy.

collectibles.name: Pipes
collectibles.location: On top of the right round section of the pipes bearing the Aries logo, south-east of the previous trophy.

collectibles.name: Crate cave
collectibles.location: Inside a little cave behind shipping crates, south-west of the capsule walkway trophy.

collectibles.name: Crowd Kicker containers
collectibles.location: Behind the shipping containers to the left of the Crowd Kicker building.
collectibles.method: Face the building and go left to the containers.

achievements.summary: Gather 1,000,000 crowdkicker dollars.

steps.text: After unlocking the money-spawning mutator from Fund this!, use it to generate and collect 1,000,000 crowdkicker dollars.

achievements.summary: Mine 10 pieces of channitatium.

steps.text: Headbutt 10 blue channitatium ore deposits out of the walls and process each one in a mine shredder.

achievements.summary: Find all the pony horses.

steps.text: Search the colony for every hidden pony horse and collect them all.

achievements.summary: Complete all the test chambers.

steps.text: Once you have 40,000 crowdkicker dollars, unlock the test chambers and complete every one.

achievements.summary: Drive the podracer a set distance.

steps.text: In the south-east between the test chambers and the research dome, enter the yellow podracer and drive it until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Headbutt Lawrence S.Windler in his lair.
achievements.summary: Find Lawrence S.Windler in his lair and headbutt him.

steps.text: After earning 100,000 crowdkicker dollars, accept the dinner invitation in the colony's top-left corner, talk to the CEO, and pick every dialogue option until you kick him.

achievements.displayName: splishy splashy wibbly wobbly timey wimey
achievements.summary: Visit the badehaus.

steps.text: Collect the four badehaus items: on the museum's top floor, near the Carrier crew quarters stairs, at the blue-lightsaber statue in the academy, and beside the 3D printer building in the car park.
Use the travel agency to visit the badehaus.

achievements.summary: Wrap a garl'eek in tinfoil.

steps.text: After unlocking the travel agency, go to T-xas and herd a garleek into the tinfoil machine by the pen.

achievements.summary: Tag 10 walls.

steps.text: Use the tagging ability to spray 10 walls.

achievements.description: Put a money crate in the mining shredder.
achievements.summary: Put a money crate into the mining shredder.

guide.context: A money crate comes from the money-spawning mutator awarded by Fund this!.

steps.text: At the shredder near the bottom of the quarry, throw in a money crate.

achievements.description: Wear 30 things as a hat at the same time.
achievements.summary: Wear 30 objects as hats simultaneously.

steps.text: Unlock the travel agency, go to the Carrier crew quarters, descend the stairs, and lick the three fedoras on the shelf in the first room on the left to gain the hat mutator.
Equip 30 objects as hats at once.
